cards.gloss_en: the mast nearest the front of a ship
cards.ex_en: A sailor climbed the foremast to fix the sail.
cards.ex_cn: 一名水手爬上前桅去修帆。

cards.gloss_en: a pole sticking forward from a ship's bow
cards.ex_en: The rope was tied to the bowsprit at the front.
cards.ex_cn: 绳子系在船头的斜桅上。

cards.gloss_en: the front section of something
cards.ex_en: The forepart of the boat was full of water.
cards.ex_cn: 船的前部灌满了水。

cards.gloss_en: a tool with two arms used to grip things
cards.ex_en: She lifted the hot coal with a pair of tongs.
cards.ex_cn: 她用一把火钳夹起了烫的煤块。

cards.gloss_en: a metal frame for cooking food over fire
cards.ex_en: He grilled the fish on an iron gridiron.
cards.ex_cn: 他把鱼放在铁烤架上烤。

cards.gloss_en: pieces of fruit preserved in sugar
cards.ex_en: The old shop still sells sweet orange succades.
cards.ex_cn: 那家老店仍在卖甜甜的橙子蜜饯。

cards.gloss_en: old Spanish gold coins
cards.ex_en: The chest was full of shining gold doubloons.
cards.ex_cn: 箱子里装满了闪亮的达布隆金币。

cards.gloss_en: small bottles for holding liquid
cards.ex_en: They filled two flasks with fresh water.
cards.ex_cn: 他们把两个细颈瓶装满了清水。

cards.gloss_en: old Spanish silver coins
cards.ex_en: He counted fifty rials in the sailor's bag.
cards.ex_cn: 他数出水手袋子里的五十枚里亚尔银币。

cards.gloss_en: something that serves as a warning or reminder
cards.ex_en: His failure was a memento to the younger workers.
cards.ex_cn: 他的失败成了年轻工人的一个警示。

cards.gloss_en: belonging to an early and simple stage
cards.ex_en: They lived in a primitive hut made of leaves.
cards.ex_cn: 他们住在一间用树叶盖的原始小屋里。

cards.gloss_en: coming after something else in time
cards.ex_en: The first plan failed, but subsequent ones worked.
cards.ex_cn: 第一个计划失败了,但随后的计划成功了。

cards.gloss_en: ideas or notions formed in the mind
cards.ex_en: Children often have simple conceptions of the world.
cards.ex_cn: 孩子对世界常有简单的观念。

cards.gloss_en: the state of being alone
cards.ex_en: He enjoyed the solitude of the quiet mountains.
cards.ex_cn: 他喜欢静谧群山中的独处。

cards.gloss_en: a main road or passage running through
cards.ex_en: The market stood on the town's busy thoroughfare.
cards.ex_cn: 集市坐落在镇上繁忙的大道旁。

cards.gloss_en: a much smaller version of something
cards.ex_en: He painted the whole city in miniature.
cards.ex_cn: 他把整座城市画成了缩影。

cards.gloss_en: a shortened version of a text
cards.ex_en: I read an abridgment of the long novel.
cards.ex_cn: 我读了那部长篇小说的删节本。

cards.gloss_en: visited a place often
cards.ex_en: Birds frequented the pond every morning.
cards.ex_cn: 鸟儿每天早上都常来这个池塘。

cards.gloss_en: not able to do something
cards.ex_en: The tired child was incapable of walking further.
cards.ex_cn: 疲惫的孩子无力再往前走。

cards.gloss_en: bringing useful benefit or advantage
cards.ex_en: The long talk was profitable to both of us.
cards.ex_cn: 那次长谈对我们俩都很有益。

cards.gloss_en: to draw someone's attention away
cards.ex_en: Loud noises distract me while I study.
cards.ex_cn: 吵闹声让我学习时分心。

cards.gloss_en: a state of calm and peace
cards.ex_en: The garden filled her with tranquillity.
cards.ex_cn: 花园让她心中充满宁静。

cards.gloss_en: a wading bird with a long curved bill
cards.ex_en: A curlew called out across the wet marsh.
cards.ex_cn: 一只麻鹬在湿地上鸣叫。

cards.gloss_en: to say false things to harm someone
cards.ex_en: It is wrong to slander an honest man.
cards.ex_cn: 诽谤一个诚实的人是不对的。

cards.gloss_en: extremely cruel behaviour
cards.ex_en: The prisoners suffered great inhumanity.
cards.ex_cn: 囚犯们受到极大的不人道对待。

cards.gloss_en: the state of continuing over time
cards.ex_en: The continuance of the rain ruined the crops.
cards.ex_cn: 雨的持续毁了庄稼。

cards.gloss_en: a state of great excitement or agitation
cards.ex_en: The whole city was in a ferment of joy.
cards.ex_cn: 整座城市陷入一片欢腾的骚动。

cards.gloss_en: intense passion or enthusiasm
cards.ex_en: She spoke about her dream with great fervour.
cards.ex_cn: 她满怀热忱地谈起自己的梦想。

cards.gloss_en: going far beyond what is reasonable
cards.ex_en: He made extravagant promises he could not keep.
cards.ex_cn: 他做出了自己无法兑现的过度承诺。

cards.gloss_en: a low and sad state of mind
cards.ex_en: A look of dejection crossed his face.
cards.ex_cn: 他脸上掠过一丝沮丧。

cards.gloss_en: a group of people travelling together
cards.ex_en: A caravan of traders crossed the desert.
cards.ex_cn: 一队商人穿越了沙漠。

cards.gloss_en: the quality of being allowed by law
cards.ex_en: They questioned the lawfulness of the order.
cards.ex_cn: 他们质疑这道命令的合法性。

cards.gloss_en: attacking someone violently
cards.ex_en: The soldiers were assaulting the castle walls.
cards.ex_cn: 士兵们正在攻击城堡的墙。

cards.gloss_en: to make two things agree with each other
cards.ex_en: It is hard to reconcile these two stories.
cards.ex_cn: 很难把这两个说法调和一致。

cards.gloss_en: to plan or manage something cleverly
cards.ex_en: He contrived a way to open the locked door.
cards.ex_cn: 他设法想出了打开那扇锁门的办法。

cards.gloss_en: the act of watching or searching for enemies
cards.ex_en: He kept on the scout for any strangers.
cards.ex_cn: 他一直放哨提防陌生人。

cards.gloss_en: a heavy stick used as a weapon
cards.ex_en: The guard carried a thick wooden club.
cards.ex_cn: 卫兵拿着一根粗大的木棍棒。

cards.gloss_en: the art or practice of cooking food
cards.ex_en: She learned cookery from her grandmother.
cards.ex_cn: 她跟祖母学了烹饪。

cards.gloss_en: ran faster than and left behind
cards.ex_en: The young runner outstripped all the others.
cards.ex_cn: 那名年轻选手跑过了所有人。

cards.gloss_en: in a way impossible to resist
cards.ex_en: The smell of bread drew him irresistibly to the shop.
cards.ex_cn: 面包的香味不可抗拒地把他引向那家店。

cards.gloss_en: people who are chasing someone
cards.ex_en: The thief ran fast to escape his pursuers.
cards.ex_cn: 小偷飞奔以摆脱追赶者。

cards.gloss_en: shouting loudly to call out
cards.ex_en: The men came hallowing across the field.
cards.ex_cn: 那些人一路大声呼喊着跑过田野。

cards.gloss_en: an amount of liquid drunk in one go
cards.ex_en: He drank a long draught of cold water.
cards.ex_cn: 他大口喝下一饮凉水。

cards.gloss_en: pleasant and attractive in appearance
cards.ex_en: She was a comely girl with a kind smile.
cards.ex_cn: 她是个笑容和善、模样清秀的姑娘。

cards.gloss_en: bad-tempered and unfriendly
cards.ex_en: The surly shopkeeper never smiled at anyone.
cards.ex_cn: 那个阴沉粗暴的店主从不对人笑。

cards.gloss_en: of a dull greyish-brown colour
cards.ex_en: The old horse had a dun coat.
cards.ex_cn: 那匹老马长着暗褐色的皮毛。

cards.gloss_en: of a yellowish-green or brownish colour
cards.ex_en: He had smooth olive skin.
cards.ex_cn: 他有着光滑的橄榄色皮肤。

cards.gloss_en: pleasantly round and full in shape
cards.ex_en: The baby had plump little cheeks.
cards.ex_cn: 那婴儿有着圆胖的小脸蛋。

cards.gloss_en: the hard white substance of tusks
cards.ex_en: The comb was carved from smooth ivory.
cards.ex_cn: 那把梳子是用光滑的象牙雕成的。

cards.gloss_en: a silly or playful piece of behaviour
cards.ex_en: The clown's antic made the children laugh.
cards.ex_cn: 小丑滑稽古怪的动作把孩子们逗笑了。

cards.gloss_en: the state of being under someone's control
cards.ex_en: The people lived in subjection to the king.
cards.ex_cn: 百姓屈从于国王的统治。

cards.gloss_en: the condition of being forced to serve
cards.ex_en: They were kept in harsh servitude for years.
cards.ex_cn: 他们多年被残酷地奴役着。

cards.gloss_en: to dip bread into a liquid
cards.ex_en: He liked to sop his bread in the soup.
cards.ex_cn: 他喜欢把面包蘸在汤里。

cards.gloss_en: did as one was asked or ordered
cards.ex_en: She complied at once with the teacher's request.
cards.ex_cn: 她立刻照老师的要求做了。

cards.gloss_en: to bring food up from the stomach
cards.ex_en: The rough sea made him vomit.
cards.ex_cn: 颠簸的海浪让他呕吐起来。

cards.gloss_en: skilfully with the hands
cards.ex_en: She dexterously tied the tiny knot.
cards.ex_cn: 她灵巧地打好那个小结。

cards.gloss_en: coloured or stained a certain colour
cards.ex_en: She dyed the white cloth deep blue.
cards.ex_cn: 她把白布染成了深蓝色。

cards.gloss_en: badly torn or crushed
cards.ex_en: The machine mangled the metal bar.
cards.ex_cn: 机器把那根金属条砸烂了。

cards.gloss_en: a strong longing for something
cards.ex_en: She had a hankering for sweet cakes.
cards.ex_cn: 她很馋甜甜的蛋糕。

cards.gloss_en: a close-fitting sleeveless jacket
cards.ex_en: The hunter wore a leather jerkin.
cards.ex_cn: 猎人穿着一件皮制的紧身短上衣。

cards.gloss_en: blocked or fastened with a bar
cards.ex_en: They barred the door before nightfall.
cards.ex_cn: 天黑前他们把门闩住了。

cards.gloss_en: furthest inside
cards.ex_en: The treasure lay in the innermost room.
cards.ex_cn: 宝藏藏在最里面的房间里。

cards.gloss_en: tall grasses growing near water
cards.ex_en: Ducks hid among the tall reeds.
cards.ex_cn: 野鸭藏在高高的芦苇丛中。

cards.gloss_en: an action taken to avoid danger
cards.ex_en: As a precaution, he locked every window.
cards.ex_cn: 作为预防措施,他锁上了每一扇窗。

cards.gloss_en: a gloomy and silent bad mood
cards.ex_en: His sullenness spoiled the whole party.
cards.ex_cn: 他的阴郁扫了整场聚会的兴。

cards.gloss_en: gave up something valuable for a cause
cards.ex_en: She sacrificed her free time to help others.
cards.ex_cn: 她牺牲了空闲时间去帮助别人。

cards.gloss_en: at all, used to stress a negative
cards.ex_en: There was no food whatsoever in the house.
cards.ex_cn: 屋里丝毫没有吃的。

cards.gloss_en: putting a power or effort into use
cards.ex_en: He won by exerting all his strength.
cards.ex_cn: 他使出全身力气才赢了。

cards.gloss_en: having knowledge and clear understanding
cards.ex_en: An enlightened ruler listened to his people.
cards.ex_cn: 一位开明的君主愿意倾听百姓。

cards.gloss_en: to intrude on or violate something
cards.ex_en: Do not invade another person's privacy.
cards.ex_cn: 不要侵犯别人的隐私。

cards.gloss_en: to accuse or find fault with
cards.ex_en: He dared to arraign the judge's decision.
cards.ex_cn: 他竟敢指责法官的判决。

cards.gloss_en: based on personal whim, not on reason
cards.ex_en: The teacher's arbitrary rules confused us.
cards.ex_cn: 老师那些武断的规矩把我们弄糊涂了。

cards.gloss_en: doing wrong against God or morals
cards.ex_en: The priest warned them against sinning.
cards.ex_cn: 牧师警告他们不要犯罪。

cards.gloss_en: a person who makes pots from clay
cards.ex_en: The potter shaped a bowl on his wheel.
cards.ex_cn: 陶工在转盘上塑出一只碗。

cards.gloss_en: quickest and most able to learn
cards.ex_en: She was the aptest pupil in the class.
cards.ex_cn: 她是班上最聪敏的学生。

cards.gloss_en: to feel or cause disgust and sickness
cards.ex_en: The smell of rot began to nauseate him.
cards.ex_cn: 腐烂的气味让他开始作呕。

cards.gloss_en: genuine and not pretended
cards.ex_en: She thanked him with unfeigned joy.
cards.ex_cn: 她怀着真诚的喜悦向他道谢。

cards.gloss_en: a strong pull of flowing water
cards.ex_en: The boat was pulled along by the draft of the river.
cards.ex_cn: 小船被河水的牵引带着走。

cards.gloss_en: the flowing back of water
cards.ex_en: The reflux of the tide dragged the sand away.
cards.ex_cn: 退潮的回流把沙子卷走了。

cards.gloss_en: to save someone from sin
cards.ex_en: They believed the hero came to redeem them.
cards.ex_cn: 他们相信那位救主前来救赎他们。

cards.gloss_en: the scheming of priests for power
cards.ex_en: He mocked the priestcraft that fooled the poor.
cards.ex_cn: 他嘲笑那愚弄穷人的教士权术。

cards.gloss_en: people who worship many gods
cards.ex_en: The old pagans prayed to the sun and moon.
cards.ex_cn: 古时的异教徒向日月祈祷。

cards.gloss_en: deep respect mixed with awe
cards.ex_en: The old teacher was held in great veneration.
cards.ex_cn: 人们对这位老教师十分崇敬。

cards.gloss_en: an old past-tense form of speak
cards.ex_en: The prophet spake to the gathered crowd.
cards.ex_cn: 先知向聚集的人群说话。

cards.gloss_en: armed resistance against authority
cards.ex_en: The angry farmers rose in rebellion.
cards.ex_cn: 愤怒的农民揭竿反叛。

cards.gloss_en: deep hatred or hostility
cards.ex_en: There was long enmity between the two families.
cards.ex_cn: 这两家之间有着长久的敌意。

cards.gloss_en: to make someone believe what is false
cards.ex_en: Do not let false hopes delude you.
cards.ex_cn: 别让虚假的希望蒙骗了你。

cards.gloss_en: those who tempt others to do wrong
cards.ex_en: He turned away from the smiling tempters.
cards.ex_cn: 他避开了那些笑脸相迎的诱惑者。

cards.gloss_en: to fix something firmly in the mind
cards.ex_en: The lesson was imprinted on her memory.
cards.ex_cn: 这个教训铭刻在她的记忆里。

cards.gloss_en: fairness and even-handed justice
cards.ex_en: The judge ruled with wisdom and equity.
cards.ex_cn: 法官以智慧和公正作出裁决。

cards.gloss_en: unlimited and total power
cards.ex_en: Believers praised the omnipotence of their god.
cards.ex_cn: 信徒们赞颂他们神的全能。

cards.gloss_en: to put out a fire
cards.ex_en: Rain helped quench the forest fire.
cards.ex_cn: 雨帮着扑灭了森林大火。

cards.gloss_en: burning or full of fire
cards.ex_en: The dragon breathed a fiery blast.
cards.ex_cn: 巨龙喷出一股炽热的火焰。

cards.gloss_en: one who resolves tricky moral questions
cards.ex_en: The clever casuist argued both sides at once.
cards.ex_cn: 那位机敏的决疑者同时替两方辩理。

cards.gloss_en: a person who solves problems
cards.ex_en: She was a quick solver of hard puzzles.
cards.ex_cn: 她是解答难题的高手。

cards.gloss_en: having no bottom, extremely deep
cards.ex_en: The cave seemed to hide a bottomless pit.
cards.ex_cn: 洞里似乎藏着一个无底深坑。

cards.gloss_en: lasting forever
cards.ex_en: They swore everlasting friendship.
cards.ex_cn: 他们立誓结下永恒的友谊。

cards.gloss_en: forgave and excused a wrong
cards.ex_en: The king pardoned the frightened prisoner.
cards.ex_cn: 国王赦免了那个惊恐的囚犯。

cards.gloss_en: a solemn and binding agreement
cards.ex_en: The two peoples made a lasting covenant.
cards.ex_cn: 两族人立下了一个持久的契约。

cards.gloss_en: a low stool for resting the feet
cards.ex_en: She rested her tired feet on a footstool.
cards.ex_cn: 她把疲惫的双脚搁在脚凳上。

cards.gloss_en: one who makes a person holy
cards.ex_en: They prayed to their sanctifier for a pure heart.
cards.ex_cn: 他们向使成圣者祈求一颗纯洁的心。

cards.gloss_en: in a way that saves the soul
cards.ex_en: He hoped the words would work savingly on their hearts.
cards.ex_cn: 他盼这些话能有助救赎地打动他们的心。

cards.gloss_en: belonging to the earthly world
cards.ex_en: He cared little for sublunary riches.
cards.ex_cn: 他并不看重尘世的财富。

cards.gloss_en: a change to a better way of living
cards.ex_en: His release led to a true reformation of his life.
cards.ex_cn: 获释让他的生活有了真正的悔改。

cards.gloss_en: the act of obeying rules or orders
cards.ex_en: The dog showed perfect obedience to its master.
cards.ex_cn: 那只狗对主人完全顺从。
